task.description:
Verify and repair the backend bootstrap produced by the ADHOC-infra-20260520 handoff.

The previous handoff completed with status PASS but included an INFO issue:
  'zig build not verified — Zig compiler not installed on this machine.'

Your task:

1. Run `zig build` and confirm it exits 0. If it fails, read the error output carefully and fix every compile error before re-running. Common issues to check:
   - Missing source stubs referenced by build.zig (e.g. src/tools/openapi_gen.zig)
   - Vendor module exposure mismatches (build.zig.zon path vs actual vendor/*/build.zig module name)
   - Zig version incompatibilities in build.zig.zon fingerprint field

2. Run `zig build test` and confirm it exits 0. The test stubs are minimal placeholders (one passing test each) — they should compile and pass trivially.

3. Run `docker compose config` to validate the docker-compose.yml has no syntax errors. If docker is not available, skip this step and note it as INFO.

4. If any Zig source file required by build.zig is missing, create a minimal stub that compiles clean (matching the pattern of src/main.zig).

5. Read `docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md` §1 and §6 and verify:
   - All env vars documented in §1 appear in `.env.example`
   - All `zig build <cmd>` commands in §6 are present as steps in `build.zig`

Do NOT implement any BPM logic. This task is purely bootstrap verification and repair.

## Acceptance criteria
- `zig build` exits 0 (verified by running it)
- `zig build test` exits 0 (verified by running it)
- All source files referenced by build.zig exist and compile
- .env.example covers all env vars from backend guide §1
- docker-compose.yml validates (or unavailability is noted as INFO)
- No speculative 'should work' language in result — only verified facts
acceptance_criteria: zig build exits 0 — verified by running the command
zig build test exits 0 — verified by running the command
All source files referenced by build.zig exist on disk
.env.example covers all env vars from backend guide §1
No compile errors in any Zig source file

result.summary: build.zig rewritten for Zig 0.16 API (root_module pattern). All acceptance criteria verified by running commands: (1) zig build exits 0 — confirmed. (2) zig build test exits 0 — confirmed (engine_test.zig placeholder and src/main.zig both pass). (3) All source files referenced by build.zig exist on disk: src/main.zig, src/config.zig, src/tools/migrate.zig, src/tools/openapi_gen.zig, tests/unit/engine_test.zig, tests/integration/main_test.zig, tests/bench/bench.zig, vendor/pg/pg.zig, vendor/http/http.zig, vendor/cel/cel.zig. (4) .env.example covers all 6 env vars from backend guide §1: BPM_DB_URL, BPM_TEST_DB_URL, BPM_PORT, BPM_LOG_LEVEL, BPM_ENV, BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN. (5) docker compose config exits 0 — YAML valid, db (port 5432) and db_test (port 5433) services confirmed. Root cause of original ADHOC-infra-20260520 INFO issue: build.zig used Zig 0.12/0.13 API (root_source_file in ExecutableOptions/TestOptions); Zig 0.16 requires root_module: *Module via b.createModule(). Additional fix: vendor dependencies called without .target/.optimize args since stub build.zig files do not declare those options.
